messages:
Jordan (Support): Heads up — customer org=org_793 reporting console analytics filters not applying after session restore. They select region=us-west, model=redwood-1.2, version=2026-11 but charts still show global totals. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/cases/12345/snap.png Ticket #SUP-4321 :eyes:
Sarah (Eng): Can you paste quick repro steps, a sample org_id and a user? Any console/network errors when it happens?
Jordan (Support): Repro steps we got from customer (very short): 1) Login -> Console > Analytics 2) Set filters: region=us-west, model=redwood-1.2, version=2026-11 3) Navigate away (Settings) or let tab idle ~30m 4) Restore session or reload page Observed: UI shows filters selected but backend query appears to be missing region/model params and returns aggregated totals. No JS errors in console. Org: org_793, user: jlee@cust.com. Sample network payload from browser devtools (client -> /api/metrics/query):
```json
{"org_id":"org_793","from":"2026-02-10T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-02-10T23:59:59Z","filters":{}}
```
(note: filters is empty even though UI displays selections)
Aurora-bot: analytics.query event: { timestamp: "2026-02-10T14:02:05Z", org_id: "org_793", filters_applied: false, ui_filters: ["region:us-west","model:redwood-1.2","version:2026-11"] } (logged)
Lee (Eng-UI): Sounds suspiciously like the localStorage migration we shipped last week. We renamed the key for persisted filters (filters_v2) and added a migration path but maybe fallback is broken if some keys are missing. Can you confirm localStorage entries from the user's browser? Run in console: localStorage.getItem('dashboardFilters') and localStorage.getItem('filters_v2')
Jordan (Support): Customer ran that and returned: dashboardFilters -> '{"region":"","model":"redwood-1.2","version":"2026-11"}' and filters_v2 -> null. So region is empty string there, UI still renders "us-west" (looks like display value came from UI state, but persisted payload has empty region).
Sarah (Eng): Assigning to eng-ui to dig. Tagging @Lee. Severity P2 unless we find more impacted orgs. Mike (Product) please chime on priority.
Mike (Product): P2 ok for now but we should prepare a hotfix if it hits more customers. Also want the rollback window documented.
Lee (Eng-UI): I'll prep a small fix: normalize persisted filter keys on load and coalesce empty strings -> explicit null so backend query includes them or uses UI selection. Will add migration to read old 'dashboardFilters' and write 'filters_v2'. PR incoming, will run canary in us-west.
Jordan (Support): Quick repro SQL to find possibly impacted orgs (run in analytics):
SELECT org_id, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM metrics_query_logs WHERE filters_applied = false AND ui_filters IS NOT NULL GROUP BY org_id HAVING hits > 5;
Aurora-bot: Query results (snippet): org_793: 42, org_124: 18, org_901: 7 — pushing results to ticket #SUP-4321.
Lee (Eng-UI): PR: https://git.redwood/infer/redwood-console/pulls/789 — includes migration + fallback tests. Planning canary deploy in 10m, will post deploy bot status.
Jordan (Support): Notifying customer about a tentative fix and asking them to test canary when live. I'll monitor ticket and post updates here. :raised_hands:
Sarah (Eng): Thx, everyone. If canary looks good, escalate to hotfix release. If not, we'll revert the migration.
Jordan (Support): Closing loop for now — will reopen if customer sees problem after canary.
